model_output.verdict: Your product design work at Loop Fitness is easy to recognize, but your current role is outside design. I’d hesitate because I can’t tell what your designs changed or whether you’ve worked on design since Loop.
write_up: You’ve designed apps at Loop Fitness and sites and screens at Brightpath Studio, and you now work at Ferry Street Coffee. It’s common for design resumes to name the deliverables but leave out the problems behind them. Here, that makes it difficult for a recruiter to distinguish your work from other product designers’ in a pile.

The line about creating Loop Fitness’s first design system in Figma is the model: it names what you made, where it was used and the tool. Your current job accounts for the recent time, but the resume doesn’t show any design work after February 2024.
